Tarte au chocolat sans cuisson 🍫 Ingrédients (cercle de 18 cm) La croûte • 120 g de biscuits au cacao • 55 g de beurre fondu La ganache au chocolat au lait • 300 g de chocolat au lait • 120 g de crème entière fluide • 50 g de lait entier • 1 pincée de sel • 15 g de beurre mou Préparation 1. Préparer la croûte • Mixez les biscuits au cacao jusqu’à obtenir une poudre fine. • Versez le beurre fondu dessus puis mélangez jusqu’à obtenir une texture de sable humide. • Déposez ce mélange dans le cercle de 18 cm  chemisé posé sur une assiette ou un plat. • Tassez bien le fond et les bords avec le dos d’une cuillère ou un verre. • Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 20 minutes pour raffermir la base. 2. Préparer la ganache au chocolat  • Hachez le chocolat au lait si vous utilisez des tablettes et placez-le dans un saladier. • Dans une casserole, chauffez la crème, le lait entier  jusqu’à frémissement. • Versez le liquide chaud sur le chocolat. • Ajoutez la pincée de sel.  • Attendez 1 minute puis mélangez doucement de l'intérieur vers l'extérieur jusqu’à obtenir une ganache lisse et brillante. • Ajoutez le beurre mou et mélangez encore pour obtenir une texture parfaitement lisse. • Versez la ganache sur la croûte froide. • Réfrigérez au minimum 4 heures, idéalement une nuit entière. Pain au Chocolat Recipe 🍫🥐 An Delight of Tender Chocolate and Airy Pastry. The classic elegance of Pain au Chocolat enchants taste buds around the world. This French pastry is an irresistible delicacy, weaving its magic across palates. It's an experience that shouldn't be missed. Makes 8-10 pieces 🥛 Dough: - 180 ml chilled milk - 18 g sugar - 25 g fresh yeast - 35 g cold butter - About 6 g salt - 380 g flour (Type 550) 🍫 Filling: - 160 g cold butter - 16-20 dark chocolate strips 🥚 Brushing: - Egg yolk - 1 tbsp cream/milk 👩🏻‍🍳 Dough Prep: 1. Mix dough ingredients in a kitchen mixer, knead for 5 min. 2. Take needed butter from the fridge for lamination. 3. Roll dough to 21x25 cm. Lamination: 1. Halve 160 g butter lengthwise. 2. Fold dough over butter, wrap, chill 45+ min. 1st Turn: 1. Roll dough to 8-10 mm, fold in thirds, chill 45+ min. 2nd Turn: 1. Treat rolled dough, fold, chill 45+ min. 3rd Turn: 1. Roll, fold, chill 1-2 hours. 🥐 Shaping and Baking: 1. Roll proofed dough to 15x4 mm. 2. Cut 15 cm x 8.5 cm strips. 3. Place halved chocolate bars on dough, roll. 4. Put rolled dough, seams down, on parchment-lined sheet. 5. Proof 2-2.5 hours at room temp. 6. Brush with egg yolk, cream/milk mixture. 7. Preheat oven to 180°C (356°F), bake 20 min. Optional: Brush with maple syrup after baking. Enjoy your homemade Pain au Chocolat! 🥐🍫  #painauchocolat #dessert #cake #dessertrecipe

MOLTEN BROWNIES. The rich indulgence of a texture that collapses into molten lava. If you’ve ever been searching for a chocolate dessert that achieves the perfect balance of a crackled crust + a gooey, molten centre, this is for you. During my years operating as a private chef to various Royal Families across the Gulf, I quickly learned that despite the opulence, what the Lady of the House truly craved at the end of the day was pure, basic comfort food. This particular recipe became her absolute favourite treat because it stripped away unnecessary pretence + focused entirely on flawless execution. It’s a simple sensation, born from technical precision + a refusal to compromise on the quality of the ingredients. This is not your ordinary brownie; it is a professional-grade masterpiece with zero compromise on texture. A deeply fudgy bake with a decadent, liquid-like centre that remains stable yet incredibly rich. High-integrity, sophisticated, + utterly irresistible. THE INGREDIENTS 220 g organic 80% dark chocolate, finely chopped 200 g organic unsalted A2 butter 3 large organic pasture-raised eggs, at room temperature 170 g organic coconut blossom sugar 40 g organic raw cacao powder 80 g organic spelt flour 8 g flaky sea salt, plus extra for garnish THE METHOD Prep Station: Preheat oven to 175°C. Grease + line 20 cm baking tin. Melt Base: Melt butter + chocolate together using bain-marie, ensuring bottom of bowl does not touch water. Dissolve Sugar: Remove from heat, stir in sugar + salt until dissolved. Use wooden spatula instead of whisk to avoid incorporating air, keeping brownie dense. This step also cools mixture. Incorporate Eggs: Ensure mixture is warm, not hot. Add eggs one at a time, whisking between each addition until batter is completely homogenous + glossy. Sift + Fold: Sift flour + cacao powder into batter. Fold gently with spatula until just combined, taking care not to overwork it. Bake for Texture: Pour into tin, tap firmly to remove air bubbles, + finish with extra flaky salt. Bake for 22 minutes until top is set + skewer comes out slightly moist! SAVE this for when you need a serious chocolate fix. It is elite.

I just wanted to bake chocolate lava cakes... Instead Evelyn cracked me, in more way than one. 🥀🍫😭 #househusbandbakes #evelynchevalier #evelynzzz #animecouplegoals #animetok  This recipe makes 4 chocolate lava cakes.  Ingredients:  • 1/2 cup (4 ounces) unsalted butter, plus more for greasing the ramekins • 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting the ramekins • 6 ounces bittersweet or dark chocolate, chopped (about 1 cup plus 1 1/2 tablespoons) You can sub in chocolate chips if its all you have. • 2 large eggs, room temperature • 2 large egg yolks, room temperature • 1/4 cup granulated sugar • 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt Directions:  Gather the ingredients. ● Preheat oven to 450°F. Butter and lightly flour four 6-ounce ramekins. Tap out excess flour. Set the ramekins on a baking sheet. ● Fill a pan/pot with water to a depth of 1 or 2 Inches depending on the depth of the pot; bring to a boil over medium-high and reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a simmer. Combine chocolate and butter in a medium size heatproof bowl and set bowl over simmering water in pan, making sure bottom of bowl doesn't touch water. Cook over medium-low, stirring occasionally and adjusting heat as needed to maintain a simmer, until chocolate mixture is melted and smooth, 10 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside. ● Beat eggs, egg yolks, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl with an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment on high speed until thickened and pale, 2 to 3 minutes ● Whisk melted chocolate until smooth ● Quickly fold melted chocolate mixture and flour into egg mixture in bowl until well combined and no streaks remain. ● Spoon batter into prepared ramekins (about 1/2 cup per ramekin) and smooth the top using a small offset spatula if needed. Place baking sheet with ramekins in the preheated oven; bake until tops of cakes are just set and edges spring back when touched but centers still feel soft, about 9 to 12 minutes. ● Remove cakes from oven and let cool in ramekins on baking sheet for 1 minute. Working with one ramekin at a time, cover ramekin with an inverted plate. Carefully turn over and let stand 10 seconds before lifting the ramekin to unmold cake. Repeat with remaining cakes. Dust with powdered sugar if you want the dominos pizza lavs cake look. Serve immediately or refrigerate for up to 3 days. Microwave briefly to reheat.
